requirements.requirement: Both at the very same corner of the same cell
requirements.evidence: Same-corner same-cell requires half base hosting drawer and participating in 3-base spike junction (e.g., 0,0,0 half-n at junction 0,0/0,1/1,0). Configurator refused co-location: SPIKE_CLASH with details.steps proposing nearest alternative junction 0,1/1,0/1,1 instead. No build variant offers both parts at identical junction; current build has spike only.

No drawer-spike pair exists to touch. Attempted touching placement at same corner was blocked by SPIKE_CLASH rule – meshes would intersect. Offered alternative keeps them on different junctions, not touching at same corner.

finish.summary: Build contains 4 bases (0,0,0 half-n, 0,1,0 half-e, 1,0,0 half-w, 1,1,0 full) and one spike at the shared northeast corner of 0,0,0. No drawer could be retained at that same corner: the configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH and removes the drawer offer when the spike occupies the junction, offering only a different junction instead. With no co-location site available, the requirement for a drawer and spike touching at the very same corner of the same cell cannot be met as written; only the spike part is shown.
